@copilot Update this PR directly in open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation on its verified head branch renovate/maintenance/v2.x-all-patch-and-minor-versions, targeting maintenance/v2.x. The user approved the previously investigated plan with: "do that plan cloud". Keep the branch assigned by GitHub Copilot cloud agent; do not rename it or create a replacement branch. Keep any platform-assigned follow-up branch if GitHub creates one.

Fix the Spotless CI failure without bulk Java formatting changes. Keep this PR's Spotless 8.11.0 upgrade and all other intended dependency updates. Explicitly pin Google Java Format to 1.36.1 using googleJavaFormat("1.36.1") in all five affected formatter configurations: conventions/src/main/kotlin/otel.spotless-conventions.gradle.kts, conventions/build.gradle.kts, benchmark-overhead/build.gradle.kts, examples/distro/buildSrc/src/main/kotlin/otel.java-conventions.gradle.kts, and examples/extension/build.gradle.kts. These standalone builds must not silently use a different formatter. Preserve other formatter settings and existing style; do not copy the massive formatting commit from main PR #21166, downgrade Spotless, or use formatting exclusions to hide violations.

Verified investigation: Spotless 8.10.4's release version catalog selects google-java-format 1.36.1 on JDK 21+, while 8.11.0 selects 2.0.0. The repository builds with JDK 25, and 1.36.1 meets the formatter's JDK-25 minimum. Spotless 8.11.0 supports an explicit formatter-version argument. The deterministic CI bundle for #21256 identifies job 128816644032, build / common / spotless, failing in :declarative-config-bridge:spotlessJavaCheck. Its diff changes the lambda wrapping in DeclarativeConfigPropertiesBridge.java at about line 138; no production fix is needed. CI invokes both ./gradlew spotlessCheck and ./gradlew -p conventions spotlessCheck, so pinning just the shared convention is insufficient.

Add a narrowly targeted maintenance-only Renovate restriction for com.google.googlejavaformat:google-java-format to retain the 1.36.1 pin across later dependency updates. Follow the repository's existing package-rule patterns and check main/maintenance configuration merging so main's formatter-update policy is not changed. Do not alter unrelated dependency constraints or the existing dependency-update groups.

Read contribution and applicable instruction files first. Run spotlessApply directly, before format checks, in the root and affected standalone builds. Validate the configurations and relevant formatter checks without running spotlessCheck as a preliminary probe. Inspect the incremental git diff against the pre-attempt head 4d232202e432638f91d22ca08d973a5a316e410c. Acceptance criteria: Spotless remains 8.11.0; all five formatter configurations pin 1.36.1; the Renovate restriction is maintenance-specific; the incremental fix has zero Java-source formatting changes and only necessary configuration edits; the other dependency updates remain intact. Report any real validation limitations instead of claiming success.

The other downloaded failed job, 128816644089 build / lint / lint-check, is a shields.io README badge HTTP 408 timeout, not a formatting issue. Retry that job if appropriate and feasible, but do not change the README link, suppress the check, or weaken lint rules. Do not make unrelated code or workflow changes, create additional requested PRs, or reply to or resolve review threads.

replies.body: Pinned Google Java Format 1.36.1 in all five configurations and added a `maintenance/v2.x`-only Renovate restriction in e786f571. Root and conventions Spotless checks pass with no Java-source diff. The standalone benchmark check finds existing Java formatting violations; distro and extension checks are blocked by unavailable Muzzle snapshots.
